title: Oo Poo Pa Do in the Rebop - CHUCK E WEISS

lines.l: He had the butterfly pads, exaggerated knees
And a long cat chain, a clean, clean, green
He had an urban borcelino and a grease down calm
And a long clean attire with spectator stomp
And everything that he owned was pink and black
Now lay, lay, lay, for all your searches implied
When the wind screams wild to the hipsters alive
Melaroonie died as they scottin' so tired
They scottin' whoop-whoop-a-doo in the rebop
